units: <cite ref="Berakhot 4a:15">Ber. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>שמא יגרום הח׳</he> perhaps sin is the cause (preventing the fulfillment of divine promise).
<cite ref="Berakhot 4a:18">Ib.</cite> <he>אלא שגרם הח׳</he> but for sin that prevented it.

<cite ref="Shabbat 119b:10">Sabb. 119ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="E00042"><he>הֶבֶל</he></cite>; a. fr.—<he>יְרֵא ח׳</he>, <he>יִרְאַת ח׳</he>, v. <cite ref="J00591"><he>יָרֵא</he></cite> a. <cite ref="J00592"><he>יִרְאָה</he></cite>.—In Talm. Y. also <cite ref="H00575"><he>חֵט</he></cite>. Y. Sabb. I, 3ᶜ top; a. fr.—Pl. <he>חֲטָאִים</he>.
Ber. 10ᵃ (ref. to חַטָּאִים, Ps. CIV, 35) מי כתיב חוֹטְאִים ח׳ כתיב does the text read ḥot’im (sinners), it may be read ḥătaim (sins).
<cite ref="Psalms 104:35">Ib.</cite> <he>כיון דְיִתַּמּוּ ח׳ וכ׳</he> when sins shall cease, the wicked shall be no more.
